methodology.compile: Fresh project/build directory per measured compile; OS caches uncontrolled, no cold-cache claim
methodology.runtime: Fresh process per sample; includes startup, no steady-state-only JIT claim
methodology.order: Rotate variants by repetition, reverse odd repetitions
methodology.memory: wait4 peak RSS from a small C parent; includes child setup/loader, is not live heap; zero means below Linux sampling visibility
methodology.cpu: wait4 user+system time for child, including waited compiler descendants
methodology.artifacts: Native ELF vs generated JS payload vs dynamically linked C ELF; external runtimes/libraries excluded and explicitly required

limitations: Surface microbenchmarks on one shared host, not a language ranking
Native checked Int, JS Number and C int64_t differ; chosen values stay in the common exact range
C has volatile runtime input and O2/O3 optimization; identical Gleam source embeds bounded inputs
C list baseline uses one explicit allocation pool; JS uses managed objects; native uses a bounded bump arena
Upstream wrapper calls exported run and prints integer; native main echoes it; upstream echo formatting is not timed
Short startup samples approach process-launch/RSS measurement floors
